items.title: Agudo (RS) Transport & vehicles procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 11 #56
items.en_title: Agudo (RS) Transport & vehicles procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 11 #56
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Agudo (RS) is procuring vehicles, transport or related equipment and services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 109,656; proposals close Dec 11, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
